name: Mo Es Governance For Cowork
description: Constitutional AI governance for Claude Cowork — no shell dependencies, prompt-native enforcement. Set behavioral modes (High Security, High Integrity, Creative, Research, and more), enforce role hierarchy (Primary → Secondary → Observer), and control posture (SCOUT / DEFENSE / OFFENSE) directly in any Cowork session. Includes 8 governance skills and 8 slash commands. Built on MO§ES™ by Ello Cello LLC. Patent-pending (Serial No. 63/877,177).
longDescription:
Ships **8 skills** and **11 commands**.

- **Skills** (8): `audit` (Produces a structured summary of all governed actions, mode changes, and decisions made in this session), `docs` (Activates session-wide document governance: sequential numbering (001_, 002_...), structured headers, and cross-reference tracking on every document produced), `govern` (Sets a constitutional governance mode that constrains Claude's behavior for the entire session — accuracy, security, creativity, or…), `posture` (Sets the operational posture for the session — Scout (read-only), Defense (protect existing state), or Offense (execute and…), `role` (Sets the agent role in a MO§ES™ hierarchy — Primary, Specialist, or Observer — controlling authority level and…), `stamp` (Embeds a MO§ES™ governance stamp into every document produced — active mode, posture, session ID, and integrity hash), `status` (Reports the complete current governance state — active mode, posture, role, vault contents, and event count), `vault` (Loads a governance document into active session context so it applies to all subsequent responses)
- **Commands** (11): `audit` (View the MO§ES™ governance audit trail for this session), `coverify` (Verify commitment conservation between two texts), `docs` (Activate MO§ES™ document governance), `govern` (Set the active MO§ES™ governance mode), `hash` (Generate a session integrity hash — a fingerprint of the current governance state and conversation content), `lineage` (Declare and verify the MO§ES™ lineage anchor for this session), `posture` (Set operational posture), `role` (Set agent role in the MO§ES™ hierarchy), and 3 more

Installs with `claude plugin install mo-es-governance-for-cowork@claude-community` from `SunrisesIllNeverSee/moses-governance-cowork`.
